title: SAM OS SSE4.2 Hardware INT8 Path — MXCSR Init

additions: Set CR4.OSFXSR (bit 9) before ldmxcsr — required for FXSAVE/LDMXCSR, without it LDMXCSR raises #UD
Set CR4.OSXMMEXCPT (bit 10) — enables #XM exception handling for SSE
fninit — resets x87 FPU to default state
ldmxcsr [rel mxcsr_default] — loads 0x1F80: masks all SSE FP exceptions, round-to-nearest
boot_asm_changes.root_cause_of_previous_crash: GRUB2 does not set CR4.OSFXSR. LDMXCSR executed without this bit raises #UD (undefined instruction) which silently triple-faults with no serial output.

simd_engine.bias_scheme: Input 'a' biased +128 to treat as uint8; bias compensated via -128*sum(b) in result
